units.source_text: 朱雀院送来的作品中，有描写宫中一年内种种仪式的画，是前代诸优秀画家所作，

en.t: Among the works sent by Suzaku-in were paintings depicting the various ceremonies held in the palace throughout the year, made by outstanding painters of an earlier reign,

units.source_text: 画得非常精美而富有趣味，上有延喜帝亲笔题词。

en.t: and they were painted with great refinement and charm, with inscriptions written in Emperor Engi's own hand.

units.source_text: 又有描写朱雀院治世种种事件的画卷，其中有当年斋宫下伊势时在大极殿举行加栉仪式之状。

en.t: There were also picture scrolls showing various events from Suzaku-in's reign, including the scene of the comb-placing ceremony held in the Daigokuden when the Saigu set out for Ise that year.

units.source_text: 此乃朱雀院所最关情之事，曾将当时种种情状详细叮嘱名画家巨势公茂，叫他用心描绘，画得十分出色。

en.t: This was the matter closest to Suzaku-in's heart, so he had carefully explained every circumstance of the time to the famous painter Kose no Kimimochi and told him to paint it with special care, producing an exceptionally fine work.

units.source_text: 这些画装在一只非常华丽的透雕沉香木箱中，箱盖上装饰着也用沉香木做的花朵，甚是新颖。

en.t: These paintings were placed in a very splendid openwork agarwood box, whose lid was decorated with flowers also made of agarwood, giving it a strikingly novel appearance.

units.source_text: 朱雀院不写信，但命使者口头传言，那使者是在禁中兼职的左近卫中将。

en.t: Suzaku-in did not write a letter, but ordered the messenger to deliver his words orally; the messenger was a lieutenant general of the Left Imperial Guards who also held a post within the palace.

units.source_text: 那画卷中描写大极殿前前斋宫将上轿出发时的庄严情景之处，题着一首诗：

en.t: At the part of the scroll showing the solemn scene before the Daigokuden, where the former Saigu was about to board her carriage and depart, a poem was inscribed:
